name: mathd_numbertheory_227
informal_prefix: /-- One morning each member of Angela's family drank an 8-ounce mixture of coffee with milk. The amounts of coffee and milk varied from cup to cup, but were never zero. Angela drank a quarter of the total amount of milk and a sixth of the total amount of coffee. How many people are in the family? Show that it is 5.-/
formal_statement: theorem mathd_numbertheory_227 (x y n : ℕ+) (h₀ : ↑x / (4 : ℝ) + y / 6 = (x + y) / n) : n = 5 := by

name: doubling_one_iff_coset
informal_prefix: /-- A finite nonempty set A in an abelian group satisfies |A + A| = |A| if and only if A is a coset of its stabilizer. The stabilizer of a set A is defined as Stabilizer A = {h : G | h + A = A}, which forms a subgroup of G.-/
formal_statement:
theorem doubling_one_iff_coset (A : Finset G) (h_ne : A.Nonempty) :
    A.card = (A + A).card ↔ ∃ x : G, A = x +ᵥ (Stabilizer A : Set G) := by
